exercises.tip: "سن" plus "ـي" (my) gives "سنّي"; then the pain verb.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "_____ يوجعني." English meaning: My back hurts.

exercises.tip: "ضهر" is how Hejazi says back; Damascene and Gulf may differ.

challenge.title: A Visit to the Doctor and the Pharmacy
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines where you describe to a friend or doctor how you feel, mention at least two symptoms using body-part words, and then go to the pharmacy to get medicine. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 9 and include both a masculine-address and a feminine-address form somewhere in your conversation.
required_elements: A greeting and health question, like كيفك or شو اللي صار فيك.
At least two symptoms using body-part words, like راسي or بطني.
A mention of حمى or صداع or another specific complaint.
A question asking since when the person has felt this way, using من إيمتى.
A pharmacy or doctor request using عندك or أبي.
A question about a prescription using وصفة.
Instructions for taking medicine, such as مرتين في اليوم.
A closing wish using سلامتك and its reply الله يسلمك.

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.arabic: السلام عليكم يا محمود، كيفك اليوم؟ شكلك تعبان
dialogue.transliteration: assalaam 3alaykum ya ma7mood, keefak alyoom? shaklak ta3baan
dialogue.english: Hi Mahmoud, how are you today? You look tired

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.arabic: وعليكم السلام، تمام الحمد لله بس عندي صداع وحمى من أمس
dialogue.transliteration: wa 3alaykum assalaam, tamaam il-7amdu lillaah bas 3indi soda3 wa 7ummaa min ams
dialogue.english: Hi, I'm good thank God but I have a headache and fever since yesterday

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.arabic: من إيمتى بالضبط وإنت حاس هيك؟
dialogue.transliteration: min eemta biD-DabT wa inta 7ass heek?
dialogue.english: Since exactly when have you felt like this?

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.arabic: من أمس الصباح، وراسي يوجعني كتير وبطني يوجعني كمان
dialogue.transliteration: min ams iS-Saba7, wa raasi yawja3ni ktiir wa baTni yawja3ni kamaan
dialogue.english: Since yesterday morning, my head hurts a lot and my stomach hurts too

dialogue.speaker: Salim
dialogue.arabic: أنت تحتاج دكتور، روح شفهم الحين
dialogue.transliteration: ant ta7taaj doktoor, roo7 shufhum il-7een
dialogue.english: You need a doctor, go see him now

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.arabic: إيوه، بروح بعد الظهر وبعدين بمر على الصيدلية
dialogue.transliteration: eewa, broo7 ba3ad iDH-Dhuhr wa ba3deen bamurr 3ala iS-Saydaliyya
dialogue.english: Yes, I'll go this afternoon and then stop by the pharmacy

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.arabic: السلام عليكم، شو اللي يوجعك؟
dialogue.transliteration: assalaam 3alaykum, shu illii yawja3ak?
dialogue.english: What hurts you?

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.arabic: وعليكم السلام، راسي يوجعني وبطني وعندي حمى
dialogue.transliteration: wa 3alaykum assalaam, raasi yawja3ni wa baTni wa 3indi 7ummaa
dialogue.english: My head and stomach hurt and I have a fever

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.arabic: الحمد لله ما فيه حاجة خطيرة، بكتب لك وصفة وخذ الدوا
dialogue.transliteration: il-7amdu lillaah ma feeha 7aaja khaTeera, baktob lak waSfa wa khudh id-dawa
dialogue.english: Thank God it's nothing serious, I'll write you a prescription and take the medicine

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.arabic: هلا يا محمود، عندك وصفة من الدكتور؟
dialogue.transliteration: hala ya ma7mood, 3indak waSfa min id-doktoor?
dialogue.english: Hi Mahmoud, do you have a prescription from the doctor?

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.arabic: إيوه، هاد الوصفة. تحتاج وصفة ولا بيندّاع من بدون؟
dialogue.transliteration: eewa, haad il-waSfa. ta7taaj waSfa walla byindda3 min bidoon?
dialogue.english: Yes, here's the prescription. Do I need a prescription or can it be sold without?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.arabic: الحمد لله بيندّاع من بدون، خد مرتين في اليوم بعد الأكل
dialogue.transliteration: il-7amdu lillaah byindda3 min bidoon, khudh marrtein fil-yoom ba3d il-akil
dialogue.english: Thank God it's sold without, take it twice a day after eating

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.arabic: سلامتك يا محمود، وتصبح على خير
dialogue.transliteration: salamatak ya ma7mood, wa tiSba7 3ala kheir
dialogue.english: Get well soon and goodnight

dialogue.speaker: Mahmoud
dialogue.arabic: الله يسلمك، شكرا كتير
dialogue.transliteration: allah ysallmak, shukran ktiir
dialogue.english: Thank you, thanks a lot
